_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by region decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_SIBLING group overlay that emits (group_val / sibling_val * 100) per region, anchored on Ref.Sibling=(field=region, value=north). Ratio sibling of OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_SIBLING (07_process_delta_vs_sibling.json) — same (Field, Value) sibling resolver, ratio arithmetic instead of subtraction. The sibling group itself emits 100 (self-vs-self under the ratio scaling). Buffered (sibling resolution requires the full materialised SeriesPayload before the (Field, Value) lookup runs). Unknown sibling emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_UNKNOWN. Zero sibling emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO (division by zero). Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 100.
_meta.name: process-index-vs-sibling
